name: Layer-Based Cube Traversal
definition: Traverses a 3D grid of cubes layer by layer, maintaining only two layers in memory to reduce space complexity while fetching corner data for each cube.
summary: Layer-Based Cube Traversal is a memory-optimized Marching Cubes implementation that processes 3D scalar fields one z-slice at a time, maintaining only two voxel layers to reduce space complexity.
